description.en: The URL of the audio file that can be accessed over the Internet.

description.zh: asr结果的回调地址. 调用方需按照"ASR任务回调接口的模版"的数据结构准备好回调接口
description.en: The callback URL for ASR results. The caller must prepare the callback endpoint based on the data structure of the ASR task callback API template.

Valid values:
- ZH: Chinese.
- EN: English.

description.zh: 调用方定义的对本次调用的唯一业务id, 回调时将带上该字段数据和评测结果一并返回, 调用方需要保证该id全局唯一, 且可定位到自身的asr任务. 同时该字段用于幂等控制
description.en: The unique business ID defined by the caller for this request. This ID is returned with the callback along with the evaluation results. The caller must ensure that this ID is globally unique and can be traced back to its own ASR task. This field is also used for idempotence control.

title.zh: 语音转文字并标记时间
title.en: Convert speech to text with timestamps
